lines.zh: 我的身体在水里几乎笔直。
lines.en: My body runs nearly straight through the water.
One beat of my tail carries me far.
I rise from the deep.
I sweep low over the seabed.
I circle the reef.
I press your way.
I break the surface and drop back.
I leave a line of disturbed water.
I approach slowly from the dark.
My fins cut the current.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时整个身体跟着弯。
lines.en: My whole body bends into the turn.
I ride the current.
I pass beside a wreck.
I charge straight up from the depths.

lines.zh: 流线的身子，跃出水面抓鱼。
lines.en: A streamlined body, leaping out for fish.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿在水下很明显。
lines.en: My teeth show clearly underwater.
I wait for a prey's shadow.
I sway my tail slowly.
My eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉成一条直线。
lines.en: I draw my body into a straight line.

lines.zh: 我在听水里很远的声音。
lines.en: I listen to distant sounds in the water.
I make no sound, only the water moves.
I hang midwater, steady.
I patrol this area.
My fins sway gently.
I wait for the water to change.
I let my lower jaw hang.
I watch the light patches on the surface.
I raise my head from the water.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里没有多余的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing extra in my eyes.
You are smaller than I expected.

lines.zh: 我估算了一下你的长度。
lines.en: I have estimated your length.
I float slowly toward the surface.
You are on the bank; I am in the water.
My teeth show a little.
I swim around where you stand.
I raise my head a notch.
I circle you through the water.
My shadow covers the water.
You hear me breathe.
My heading slips.
My fins stiffen up.
A dark red spreads in the water.
I sink and hide away.
I flick my tail and pull away.
The pain makes me gape my jaws wide.
I fix on you, colder.
I veer off and find an angle.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下头，血丝散开。
lines.en: I shake my head and the blood thins into the water.
I rise another block.
I test it first, then clamp down.
I take it cleanly in one bite.
I gulp down water and meat together.
That will not fill a tooth gap.
I swallow it, quickly.
I lift my head for another.
I glance and sink away.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢会挣扎的东西。
lines.en: I prefer things that struggle.
I drag it into deeper water.
I circle it in the water.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被弹得很远。
lines.en: You hit me and are thrown far.
My body is harder than wood.
A boat hits me and rocks hard.
I slide past beneath your feet.
Our impact throws up a sheet of water.
I barely deviate.
My tail catches you.
The surface churns for a while.
I turn to look at you.
I shoulder you aside and keep swimming.

lines.zh: 两条巨大的身体一起游。
lines.en: Two huge bodies swim together.
Our fins nearly touch.
It circles me halfway.
We rise to the surface together.
Our tails beat the water at once.
It swims level at my flank.
We sink together.
Its bite marks are still on me.
Neither of us yields.
We head deeper together.
I bite into a plank.
I fling it into the air.
I drag it down.
It cracks in my jaws.
I push it to the surface.
I look and let go.

lines.zh: 我把它甩出水面又接住。
lines.en: I toss it above the surface and catch it.

lines.zh: 我把它拖到深水里藏好。
lines.en: I drag it into deep water and hide it.
I clamp it in my jaws.
I toss it back into the water.
I stop in the water and turn slowly.
I feel the current change.

lines.zh: 我开始朝你的方向加速。
lines.en: I begin accelerating your way.
My mouth opens slightly.
I straighten my body.
This sea is mine.

lines.zh: 我记住了你船底的形状。
lines.en: I've memorized the shape of your hull.
All my fins are spread.
I close on the bank.
I begin surging up.
I recognize the ledge you stand on.
This time I do not circle.
You back to the cliff, and I'm below.
My tail is loaded.
I follow under your hull.

lines.zh: 你划到哪里，我就在底下。
lines.en: Wherever you row, I am underneath.
I circle from the deep.
Each pass brings me closer.
My back fin slices the surface.

lines.zh: 你听见水里很闷的响声。
lines.en: You hear a muffled sound in the water.
I have not surfaced.
I press the water your way.
You look back and see only ripples.

lines.zh: 我在数你还有几个方向。
lines.en: I am counting your remaining directions.
I follow you along the cliff.
You retreat into the shallows; I come anyway.
I surface off your bow.
Large shadows appear in the water.
I stay beneath the whole time.
I bite into the hull.
I leap from the water into you.
I shake my head and rip it free.
My tail cracks the surface.
You are knocked into the water.
I bite, release, and bite again.
I drive you to the bottom.
My teeth close beside you.
You grip the planks; I am still here.

lines.zh: 这一撞让船裂开一条缝。
lines.en: The blow opens a seam in the hull.
I strike up from below.
Water floods your mouth and nose.
After the strike I sink.
You see me coming up again.
The surface suddenly sinks in one place.

lines.zh: 一个长长的影子从深处升。
lines.en: A long shadow rises from the deep.
The water pressure grows heavy.
Every fish by the bank scatters.
I swim out from behind a wreck.
You hear a great breath.
This stretch of sea goes quiet.
My back fin cuts the surface first.
I begin patrolling these waters.
I leave a track across the seabed.
Something pushes the surface up.
I slowly come into view from the dark.
The water at your feet deepens.

lines.zh: 一股很大的力气压在船上。
lines.en: A great weight presses on the boat.
I charge up from downstream.
Spray reaches the bank.
My shadow covers the whole boat.
I begin to exist and the surface drops.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我沉下去避开。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and I sink away.

lines.zh: 我被抛离水面，重重砸回来。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water and crash back in.
I choke on the water.

lines.zh: 水下炸开，我整条翻过来。
lines.en: The blast bursts and I roll over entirely.
A bolt sinks into my back.

lines.zh: 那股力量按住了我的身体。
lines.en: That force pins my body.
Hunger slows my swimming.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and locks me up.

lines.zh: 海水消失了，我一路坠下。
lines.en: The sea is gone; I fall and fall.
